title: True Best
notes: Equip best now finds the best possible combination from your bag, including set bonuses: a full Tidecaller (or any) set is equipped when 2 or 4 pieces together beat stronger single items.
Checked against trying every possible combination: 150 of 150 test bags were equipped perfectly.
Salvage useless keeps set pieces while you own pieces of that set in at least 2 slots.
